sentences.text: Platysuchus was a marine crocodylomorph belonging to the suborder Thalattosuchia and the family Teleosauridae.
The genus is named after its type species, Platysuchus multiscrobiculatus.
Originally described as the species Mystriosaurus multiscrobiculatus, it was renamed Platysuchus by Westphal in 1961 after he determined it was distinct from the genus Mystriosaurus.
Currently, there are four recorded fossil occurrences of Platysuchus in the Paleobiology Database.
This animal lived during the Early Jurassic, specifically between 184.2 and 182.9 million years ago.
Its fossils have been found in marine deposits in southern Germany and Luxembourg.
